title: Meeting sharing
description: Whether a meeting is shared with the people on its participant list.
appliesText: A saved change applies to the next change of any meeting's record: a meeting that starts, or whose participant list changes, after the save.

shareWithListedParticipants.title: Share meetings with their listed participants
shareWithListedParticipants.description: Share each meeting, read-only, with the people on its participant list, and keep the shares in step with the list.
